test_title: PYST 20: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 7 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘BRIGHT’ is written as ‘IYTRGS’ and ‘LOCATE’ is written as ‘LOZXVG’. How will ‘COSTLY’ be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet are as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

‘BRIGHT’ is written as ‘IYTRGS’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9dbda10939c3594e518be1f52d7ca3af1d9c57b02ad74920b9267171a1db203a.png] 

‘LOCATE’ is written as ‘LOZXVG’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f343a90557daee4f1b8676912478d438e41aac717ab6675f57f935bdea9e0705.png] 

Similarly, ‘COSTLY’ will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/504fb5f49670bc86a317c7f3b3fb7a64a72cd904e417dfeb64b03cc4d8df1743.png] 

Hence, **'option 4'** is the correct answer.
